title: One Tangled Cable
statementMd:
Trida attached $n$ cables to $2n$ sockets arranged from left to right. Every cable has a label from $1$ to $n$, and its two ends are attached to the two sockets carrying its label.

Two cables are tangled when their ends alternate along the row. In other words, cables $x$ and $y$ are tangled if the four relevant labels appear in the order $x,y,x,y$ or $y,x,y,x$, with other labels possibly between them.

Trida will remove exactly one entire cable, including both of its ends. Find all cables she can remove so that no two remaining cables are tangled. If zero or one cable remains after the removal, there is no tangled pair.

## Input

The first line contains one integer $n$ ($1 \le n \le 2 \times 10^5$), the number of cables.

The second line contains $2n$ integers $a_1,a_2,\ldots,a_{2n}$ ($1 \le a_i \le n$). Every integer from $1$ to $n$ occurs exactly twice.

## Output

On the first line, print the number $k$ of cables whose removal leaves no tangled pair.

On the second line, print their $k$ labels in increasing order. If $k=0$, print an empty second line.

## Note

In the sample, removing cable $2$ leaves the sequence $1,1,3,4,4,3$, which has no tangled pair. Removing any other cable leaves at least one tangled pair.
statementZhMd:
Trida 将 $n$ 根电缆连接到从左到右排列的 $2n$ 个插孔上。每根电缆都有一个从 $1$ 到 $n$ 的编号，它的两端分别连接到标有该编号的两个插孔上。

如果两根电缆的端点在这一排插孔中交替出现，则称它们相互缠绕。换句话说，如果电缆 $x$ 和 $y$ 对应的四个编号按 $x,y,x,y$ 或 $y,x,y,x$ 的顺序出现，则这两根电缆相互缠绕，其中可以夹有其他编号。

Trida 将恰好移除一整根电缆，包括它的两个端点。请找出所有可以移除的电缆，使得剩余电缆中任意两根都不相互缠绕。如果移除后只剩零根或一根电缆，则不存在相互缠绕的电缆对。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $n$（$1 \le n \le 2 \times 10^5$），表示电缆的数量。

第二行包含 $2n$ 个整数 $a_1,a_2,\ldots,a_{2n}$（$1 \le a_i \le n$）。从 $1$ 到 $n$ 的每个整数都恰好出现两次。

## 输出格式

第一行输出一个整数 $k$，表示移除后能使剩余电缆中不存在相互缠绕的电缆对的电缆数量。

第二行按升序输出这 $k$ 根电缆的编号。如果 $k=0$，则第二行输出空行。

## 说明

在样例中，移除电缆 $2$ 后，剩余序列为 $1,1,3,4,4,3$，其中不存在相互缠绕的电缆对。移除其他任何一根电缆后，都至少存在一对相互缠绕的电缆。
